findings.description: The mutate-during-iteration warning example (`items=[1,2,3,4]`, removing even numbers while iterating) happened to still produce the 'naively expected' output [1,3], since the specific values chosen meant the skipped element (index-shifted past) was itself odd and would have been kept anyway — the example failed to visibly demonstrate the danger it was meant to illustrate, undermining the callout's persuasiveness.
findings.resolution: Replaced the example data with items=[2,4,6,8] (all even, all matching the removal condition), which now visibly leaves [4,8] behind despite every element supposedly being removed — genuinely demonstrates the pitfall. Verified via direct execution.
